ai_overview.text: For fungal infection treatment in Guntur, you can consult specialized dermatologists at prominent local clinics like Leelavathi Advanced Skin and Laser Clinic in Kothapeta or major facilities such as Aster Ramesh Hospital in Nagarampalem . Consultation fees typically range from ₹300 to ₹500. Practo Top Dermatologists in Guntur Dr. Kavya Chennamsetty : Practices at Leelavathi Advanced Skin and Laser Clinic, Kothapeta (~₹350 fee). Dr. Chandrasekhar Nalabolu : Practices at Parameshwara Charmalayam, Vijayapuri South (~₹400 fee). Dr. Palakurthi Sri Sneha : Practices at Aster Ramesh Hospital, Nagarampalem (~₹500 fee). Dr. Lakshmi Kamcharla : Practices at Lakshmi Scancenter & Dermatology Clinic, Kothapeta (~₹300 fee). Practo General Treatment Approach Topical Antifungals : Creams or lotions (like clotrimazole or terbinafine) applied directly to the skin. Oral Medications : Prescription pills (like fluconazole) for stubborn or widespread infections. Care Tips : Keep the infected area dry and clean, avoid tight clothes, and finish the full medicine course.
